name: WikiSQL: Large-Scale Text-to-SQL Benchmark
description: WikiSQL is a foundational text-to-SQL benchmark containing 80,654 natural language question and SQL query pairs mapped over 24,241 relational tables extracted from Wikipedia.

license.name: BSD 3-Clause License / CC-BY-SA 3.0
license.notes: WikiSQL codebase and dataset annotations are distributed under the BSD-3-Clause license; underlying Wikipedia table content is licensed under CC-BY-SA 3.0.

source_references.title: Seq2SQL: Generating Structured Queries from Natural Language using Reinforcement Learning

verification.notes: Verified against Salesforce Research release and publication (DOI: 10.48550/arXiv.1709.00103). Contains exactly 80,654 question-SQL pairs (train: 56,355, dev: 8,421, test: 15,878) across 24,241 Wikipedia tables.

size.notes: JSONL records and SQLite database tables.
